text.p: These are the leading stories in the Moroccan press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- From tomorrow, "glacial winter" will hit Morocco. Meteorological Office forecasts snow on all the Atlas mountain chain.
- Policeman seriously wounds wife, kills himself after family dispute.
- Customs service cuts tax for month on imported long-life milk to 30 percent instead of 100 percent to try to meet shortage of milk on market.
- King Hassan awarded gold medal by International Council for Dialogue among Religions.
- Cost of living and increase in Moroccans' demands weigh heavily on purchasing power.
- Railways plan investment programme of five billion dirhams ($568 million) up to year 2000.
